doc.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09

title: Ray's Chinese cymbal and the sizzle cymbal with Zildjian
summary: Ray had Avedis Zildjian design a sizzle cymbal with rivets when Chinese cymbals could not be had because of the war between China and Japan.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: We were talking, I remember Baby Dodds once told me you're the only one that still uses the Chinese crags. Then, well, you told me you have that new...
Well, we got the new sizzle cymbal that we worked out with Mr. Bedeus Zildjian. It came about during the time of the Chinese war, the Chinese war with Japan.
Oh yeah, you couldn't get there.

And we couldn't get any. And I had a crag when I said, well, geez, I got to get something. So I just got together with Mr. Zildjian and had him design a cymbal that sounded something. I can put these rivets in and call it a sizzle cymbal.
